key.name: panel-display
key.summary: What to show in the top bar next to the icon

key.name: show-icon
key.summary: Show the icon in the top bar
key.description: The icon is always shown when the top bar is set to show only the icon.

key.name: warning-threshold
key.summary: Percentage at which a limit is shown as a warning

key.name: critical-threshold
key.summary: Percentage at which a limit is shown as critical

key.name: auto-renew
key.summary: Renew an expired Claude Code session
key.description: When the access token has expired, run “claude auth status” so Claude Code renews it. It sends no prompt and uses no plan usage.

key.name: config-dir
key.description: Folder that holds .credentials.json. Empty means $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, or ~/.claude when that is not set.
